summary: Set rust-version 1.63, removed let-else, downgraded fieldsplit to 0.4.1 (re-vendored via the mirror), made binloc inherit the workspace version, fixed core's checkchar feature, registered the formats test, fixed the no-json build, added rerun-if-changed for the site table, and added path remapping to the Makefile. make test, core-only, no-default-features, reproducible and incremental builds were verified.
